title: Distance from Earth

communication_delay_and_autonomy_constra.operational_context: Deep-space missions (lunar and future Mars transit) introduce significant signal-propagation latency and intermittent ground contact, requiring crew-autonomous health indicator gathering, local persistence, and offline-capable reference guidance.
design_implications_for_aetherion: Local-first HTTP server + SQLite storage operates without internet or cloud AI.
Deterministic GATHER -> EVALUATE -> ACT -> RECHECK care flow remains available when ground flight-surgeon contact is delayed or OFFLINE.
Explicit delivery and verification states (OFFLINE, STALE, NO_DATA, UNVERIFIED) prevent false assumptions about ground acknowledgment.

limitations: No live spacecraft telemetry link or flight-surgeon ground console is integrated; offline autonomy refers to local software continuity, not clinical self-treatment authorization.
